summary: [Client] Add Work Setups UI for Job Setup, Talent Contract Details, and Company Review
notes: The exact company management route supplied by the change context is /company/all-work-setups. Project management, job wizard, job details, hired-section, and talent contract routes are not supplied and remain UNKNOWN. No concrete company, project, job, talent, contract, work setup, family, or talent-job-work-setup IDs are available, so browser cases use exact runtime fixture policy and must be BLOCKED or MANUAL_REQUIRED until those fixtures and required states are resolved. Create, edit/version, attach, remove, talent completion/upload, rejection with note, and reupload mutation request schemas are incomplete in the supplied context; those flows require the generated API contract and runtime fixtures. Browser mutation actions are not included because only the dedicated draft-job redirect action is permitted for state-changing browser coverage. expect.notes: Verify the company Work Setups management data source returns the latest Work Setup versions for company/project management, including document requirement and reference-document metadata when present. The companyId must be resolved from execution context.

Verify the talent-facing Work Setup data source returns only Work Setups belonging to the authenticated talent's own active or started contracts and exposes status, document requirement, reference-document, and rejection-note data needed by contract details. The talentId and required contract state must be resolved from execution context.

Verify the company job-details/hired-section data source returns Work Setup progress for hired talents so the UI can show the Work Setups column and open submitted work for review. The companyId and required job/talent state must be resolved from execution context.

Verify a company user with review permission can approve a submitted Work Setup and that the resulting status is reflected after query refresh. A pending submitted talentJobWorkSetupId and companyId must be resolved from execution context; confirm the documented success status if the generated contract specifies a different 2xx response.

browserCases.goal: Verify the company All Work Setups management page uses Work Setups terminology and exposes the management surface for viewing Work Setup records and their document-related metadata.
browserCases.successCriteria: The page loads the Work Setups management surface and visibly uses the Work Setups label. When a compatible runtime Work Setup record is available, its reference-document and document-requirement information must use the Work Setup UI labels. Creation, editing/versioning, deletion, and permission-denied action visibility require manual follow-up because safe browser mutation and permission-specific fixtures are unavailable.

browserCases.successCriteria: After the runner resolves the job-create or job-edit wizard route and an exact job with zero Work Setups, the Work Setups step is visible, shows the grounded empty-state text, and does not prevent the remaining wizard flow from continuing. The route and exact job fixture are missing, so execution is BLOCKED until resolved.

browserCases.successCriteria: After the runner resolves the exact talent contract details route and required active or started contract, Work Setups is visible above Compliance Requirements. Opening a submitted record and verifying talent metadata, description, reference document, uploaded file, submitted time, approve action, rejection-note input, reject action, and reupload lifecycle require an exact submitted runtime record; browser mutation is prohibited and these checks are MANUAL_REQUIRED.
